row:
Welcome to Veterinary Medicine After Hours!

Hosted by Dr. Rene', a practicing veterinarian and practice owner, and Jenny, an experienced veterinary practice manager, Veterinary Medicine After Hours explores the real stories behind one of the most rewarding—and challenging—professions.

After the clinic closes, the filters come off. We talk about the highs, the lows, the hilarious, the heartbreaking, and everything in between. From medicine and practice management to leadership, burnout, difficult clients, unforgettable cases, and the stories every veterinary professional can relate to—nothing is off the table.

Whether you're a veterinarian, veterinary technician, assistant, receptionist, practice manager, student, or simply curious about what really happens behind the scenes, you're in the right place.

Expect honest conversations, lots of laughs, occasional soju shots, and a healthy dose of sarcasm.

Real Talk. Uncensored. Vet Stories & Soju Shots.

🐾 New episodes every week.
